item.title: Postalk - Android Note App
item.description: Postalk - Android Note App 0. Introduction This project is a web application based on Spring Boot, Mybatis, Druid, and MySQL. Its function is posting + chat. This article will record the development process and problems encountered. 1. Design Database Design To make development smoother, I first designed an ER diagram based on the relationships between entities. User Table: id username password sex age phone_number email registration_date Technology Stack Backend: Spring Boot, Spring MVC ORM: Mybatis Connection Pool: Druid Database: MySQL Frontend: Android (for the app) Project Structure src/ ├── main/ │ ├── java/ │ │ └── xyz.
